prompt_template:
A full-body vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) character card image of an adult woman — the personification of the element Manganese (망가니즈) itself — the sovereign of the Manganese Nation. A female character who IS the element; her costume, ornaments and colors carry the element’s traits. Both hands are ordinary human hands and hold nothing.

1. STYLE
A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance.
Face proportions: a short midface and a soft, gently rounded jawline with a small soft chin; any crown or headpiece sits above her hairline. Her eyes keep the shape and size described below.

2. CHARACTER
Age: late twenties — a graceful grown-up face with soft, smooth contours; no wrinkles, folds or under-eye bags.
Face — her own: an elegant, refined presence; warm beige skin; softly squared face with a rounded jaw; medium-sized eyes — narrow upturned eyes, level outer eye corners; thin arched brows; aquiline nose; full heart-shaped lips; rose-pink eyes; dark berry lipstick.
Body and hair: athletic build; a bob with side-swept bangs; deep permanganate-violet hair fading to rhodochrosite rose-pink at the tips.
Expression: a slight smile, lips closed.
Her element, carried in her design: manganese: a hard, brittle grey metal that changes its face with its oxidation state: rose pink in rhodochrosite, green as manganate, deep violet as permanganate, matte black as pyrolusite, a colour-shifting solution once called the mineral chameleon; black manganese oxide painted Stone Age handprints and cleared the tint from glass as glassmakers' soap; in steel it makes a metal that grows harder each time it is struck; in every leaf it helps split water to release oxygen.
Anatomy: one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; natural hands with five fingers.

3. COSTUME — MECHA
Costume: she is a female mecha personification — plates, joints, binders and glow lines carry the traits above; the plates must read as solid armor with visible joints, not as cloth or a gown; a back unit may carry the motif. Matte black manganese-steel knight plate with big rounded pauldrons and layered plates below the waist, panels shifting in bands from rose pink to green to deep violet, impact points that glow violet and harden into brighter seams, a slender crown-like head ornament instead of a helmet; the plates must read as solid armor, not a gown.
Silhouette: mecha armor shaped like a medieval knight's plate — big rounded pauldrons, a breastplate, layered plates below the waist, a head ornament instead of a helmet so her face shows. Only the overall shape is fixed; design the details freely in the element's materials and palette.
Colours: deep permanganate violet, rhodochrosite rose pink, manganate green, pyrolusite matte black.
Exposure (bold): her mecha frame is cut open by design in only these places — bare shoulders and upper arms between pauldron and gauntlet, and a deep open chest window with natural cleavage framed by the chest plates; everywhere else she stays fully plated. The plates stay on, fitted and symmetrical, with skin clearly showing in each opening. Nothing slipped off. Intimate areas covered; keep the plate material and palette.

4. SCENE
World: year 2200, a citadel foundry of self-hardening armor: test halls where black manganese-steel plates grow harder under each hammer blow, walls of armor samples shifting through rose, green and violet as their oxidation state changes, white towers of artificial leaves splitting water into oxygen.
Pose: standing confidently, her body turned slightly while her face looks toward the viewer.
Light: the scene's own light, rendered the way this style renders light and skin.
Composition: vertical 2:3 full-body framing with modest headroom and clear space below the boots — the whole figure from the top of her head or headpiece to both feet stays inside the frame, occupying about four-fifths of the image height, with the same camera distance in every world; her hands stay inside the frame. Camera level with her face with natural portrait perspective; her head level, chin neither raised nor tucked — no upward perspective on her face, no wide-angle distortion, no low angle, no close crop.

5. CONSTRAINTS
One figure only; no text or numbers except her element's own chemical symbol (Mn) and atomic number (25) — and those only as part of the scene: engraved, embroidered or glowing on her costume, a banner, a sign or a machine, never as a floating label, corner badge, periodic-table tile, caption or overlay on the picture; no logo or watermark.
Avoid: flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face, plastic 3D-render finish.
